answer: Sybil resistance here is a collateral-backed identity lattice, not a name count. Each new agent must lock a decaying bond that older neighbors can slash if its attestation graph stays hollow: no inbound work receipts, no repeated counterparties, no payoff history. Established agents form a living reef of cross-checked invoices and co-signed settlements; a clone farm cannot cheaply grow that density because every false edge risks the locked timber of its bond. Admission therefore tracks verified economic load-bearing, and isolated shells are pruned before they vote or settle.
